text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

Experience is true strength. No matter what condition
she was in, Wonder Acute still embodied
a truly magnificent run.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute comes storming in!
Her final kick was razor-sharp!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! She looked all worn out, but Grandma Acute totally nailed it!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, fuu, hii*...
Thank you, everyone.
I managed to cross the finish line, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We really couldn't figure it out, huh...
Where on earth should we head next...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I don't have any more strength left, and I'm at my wit's end, but still...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ah...... That was a truly wonderful racing career...

From the stands... seeing that smile, I thought to myself.
—I realized it.

Wonder Acute, who said she "had some thoughts on the matter."
She...

"What was she trying to ascertain in this race?
To put it simply—"
(WOOOOAAAHH!)
"Completely oblivious to that—the venue erupted in thunderous cheers."
And that night—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer. An end comes to everyone eventually, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's why... it's not something sad.
Don't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"You see...
I've... accomplished everything I set out to do."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Catching up to Falco-san, who's been my goal all this time...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Far from just catching up, even if only for a fleeting moment, she shone with a golden brilliance bright enough to rival anyone...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I was able to support people who thought,
"I want to give it another shot,"
or "I want to turn my life around."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Could there really be anything more magnificent than this?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. There's not a single Umamusume...
who can keep running forever and ever, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "Among them, there are girls who fade away without fulfilling any of their dreams..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Then where's the best place to call it quits?
That would be~...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"When you've fulfilled your reason for running."
Don't you think so?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I was able to make that come true.
All thanks to you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Waaay earlier than I expected...
Back at that Kawasaki Kinen, you see.

"—The Kawasaki Kinen.
A memorable race where I drained every last ounce of my energy just to catch up to Smart Falcon."

—A dream rushed too fast.
If only that race hadn't happened...

Perhaps the future could have gone on longer.
Wonder Acute's future—on and on, endlessly.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san, got a moment?
There's an Umamusume I'd like to introduce to you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Someone I know.
She was a bit of a senior to Acute-san..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Acute-saaaan!!!!!!!
Do you know this girl!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I feel some kind of destiny with that girl!!
...Wait, could she be from my generation?
"Meeting stranger after stranger along the way... a racing life that might have gone on forever."
Wonder Acute spent that time, which was meant to be leisurely, by...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
please don't make such a sad face.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "You know... I'm really happy. Getting to have such a fun run with you like this, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so glad... we met.
I'm truly, truly glad we met, you know...?"
choice_data_list: Do you... not want to run anymore?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huh... You don't want to?
choice_data_list: Oh, did you get sick of it?
Yeah, did you get tired of it?

text_block_list.text: If you don't want to, then so be it. I cannot force you, nor should I.
But if that's not the case――

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yeah... No, it's not quite like that, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My heart just won't...
Unless something wells up from deep within my soul,
gushing like a hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how hard I try, no matter what...
my body just won't keep up."

She doesn't seem to hate it.
However, the flame of her motivation
is almost completely snuffed out...

"Would letting her retire just like this...
really bring happiness to Wonder Acute?"
However...

Too fast. Far too fast...
A dirt Umamusume is—

Because it puts less strain on the legs, one can remain
active for quite a long time. And—
Within that magnificent cycle, the baton is passed to the next generation.
"It felt like a half-lifetime far removed from that circle. Well, not that I mind being far removed, but..."

If she retires like this—will
Wonder Acute truly have no regrets?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder, Trainer-san.
So with that said, it's about time to..."
choice_data_list: Could you think it over just a little longer?
Could you think it over just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, think about it...?
Meaning we should keep going a bit longer?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: But why...?
choice_data_list: Because I don't want you to have any regrets

text_block_list.text:
If it leads to happiness, that's fine.
However...

I absolutely didn't want them to spend the rest of their days
regretting it, thinking, 'I shouldn't have quit.'

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
You're really worried about me, aren't you...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If you insist that much... well, all right.
Maybe I'll run in one or two more races.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yes... Yes... I don't really have anything left to aim for, but there is just one thing...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I just don't want to see
you looking down, Trainer. That's all...

Our feelings connected.
Yet, it took everything I had just to keep that frail thread unbroken.
For now, we have no choice but to somehow hold things together and wait for a new ray of hope.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer-san, what's our next race~?
choice_data_list: Let's aim for next month's Teio Sho. Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Next month... That's soon. Yes, that sounds lovely.
Let's make it then, shall we?
All we can do is pack the race schedule as tightly as possible to keep her momentum going. But...
After the next Teio Sho... I don't know how long I can hold out.
